comment: Coverage floors for the CI coverage job (regression floors, ~1-1.5 points below measured, not tier targets; raise as coverage climbs). Mirrored into the coverage:check npm script in package.json and guarded by test/unit/coverage_thresholds_sync.test.js. Re-measured 2026-08-14 WITH the declared siblings checked out, which is what the coverage job now does: 87.93 lines/statements, 83.44 branches, 82.44 functions over 2504 unit tests (2423 without siblings); the functions floor stays at its existing 81, which is already inside the band.
vendoredExclusion: src/hub/** is excluded from the measurement (the --exclude flag rides alongside --include in both the coverage and coverage:check scripts). That directory holds nothing but the two byte-identical vendored copies of the hub-DB mirror client, hub_db_sync.js and hub-schema-version.js, which xchain-indexer/bin/sync-hub-mirror-client.sh overwrites from its canonical src/hub and whose --check step fails CI on any drift. The explorer may not edit them, so it cannot give them explorer-specific tests without drifting the twin, and their logic is covered by the canonical's own suites in the indexer; the same reasoning already carries them out of the structural ratchet via vendorPaths. Measured 2026-09-13: including them read 79.38 functions (hub_db_sync.js alone held 101 of the repo's 235 uncovered functions, 43 percent, at 14 of 115 covered) against the 81 floor; excluding them reads 86.92 functions, 93.41 lines/statements, 82.71 branches. Only this vendored directory is excluded, so a coverage regression anywhere the explorer actually owns still reddens the ratchet. Floors below are unchanged.
